scripts.source:
---@id fc4dd815-40f2-4300-944e-63660930fcb4
---@referenceName world-interface-anchor.lua
---@displayName 世界接口_传送锚点
-- The Last Terminus / A-01 -- World Interface Anchor.
-- 进入 Trigger 的本地玩家被传送到目标位置与朝向。
---@start
---@var TargetX:number=0
---@name 目标 X
---@var TargetY:number=1
---@name 目标 Y
---@var TargetZ:number=0
---@name 目标 Z
---@var TargetYaw:number=0
---@name 目标朝向
---@var CooldownSeconds:number=0.5
---@name 冷却秒数
---@end

local lastTeleportTime = -100

local function applyTeleport(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  if CS.UnityEngine.Time.time - lastTeleportTime < CooldownSeconds then return end
  lastTeleportTime = CS.UnityEngine.Time.time
  local pos = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(TargetX, TargetY, TargetZ)
  local rot = CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion.Euler(0, TargetYaw, 0)
  actor:Teleport(pos, rot)
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  applyTeleport(actor)
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
end
